notes: Counts are patients with adverse events, not episodes. The abstract states 324 patients randomized overall but no per-arm adverse-event denominator. The held registry results state 162 participants per arm for several efficacy outcomes, with smaller denominators for other efficacy analyses; these are not identified as adverse-event denominators and were not transferred. The window is the trial assessment window; a separate adverse-event collection window is NOT_IN_PACKET.
